the_review_of_0071_and_what_it_found: AN INDEPENDENT READER WAS GIVEN THE TEN CHAPTERS, THIS FILE AND THE HANDOFF ON 3 OCTOBER 2026 AND WAS TOLD TO EDIT NOTHING. ITS FULL TEXT IS *REVIEWS/VOLUME-05/CONTINUATION-0071.MD*. IT FOUND TWO BLOCKERS SEVEN MAJOR SIX MINOR AND TWO NOTES. NO CHAPTER WAS RESTARTED, NO CARD DATE GAP BAND GESTURE DOOR VISITOR DECLARED WORD OR PLANNED TURN WAS MOVED, AND THE TEN CHAPTERS STILL END ON THE TEN MOVES THIS FILE PLANNED. SIX CHAPTERS WERE TOUCHED AND FOUR WERE NOT.

BLOCKER ONE, THE VISITOR RULE, BROKEN IN SIX CHAPTERS IN A BLOCK WHOSE OWN ANTI_TICK AND OWN RECORD DECLARED IT HELD. 0897, 0899 AND 0903 EACH CARRIED A WORK REQUEST AND A REFUSAL IN VISITOR DIALOGUE, AND 0895, 0898 AND 0900 EACH PASSED THE FINDING ITSELF TO THE VISITOR IN A PASSIVE: *SHE WAS TOLD THE END STONE WAS WEDGED*, *SHE LEARNED THE SLOT FED FROM THE BED*, *SHE WAS TOLD THE HOLLOW WAS RAIN-CUT*. THE THREE FINDING PASSES USED ONE TEMPLATE SENTENCE THREE TIMES. EVERY ONE OF THE SIX WAS CUT AND THE PHYSICAL BEHAVIOUR OF THE VISITOR WAS KEPT AND EXTENDED INSTEAD. THE THREE INDIRECT CHAPTERS NOW EACH CARRY ONE DIFFERENT THING THAT IS NOT ABOUT THE JOB, WHICH IS WHAT THE RULE ALLOWS: THE BASKET OF CUTTINGS IN 0895, THE PARCEL IN 0898, THE WINDOW RUNNER IN 0900.

BLOCKER TWO, 0903'S LAST LINE ASKED THE VISITOR TO CHOOSE A BOARD. *YET WHICH LENGTH WOULD SHE LIFT FOR SHELVING TO LIE LEVEL PAST AUGUST?* IS THIRD PERSON ON HE, SHE HAS NO ANTICEDENT IN THE SENTENCE, AND THE ONLY REFERENT IS THE WOMAN WHO CAME TO THE GATE IN THE SAME CHAPTER. REWRITTEN AS A QUESTION ABOUT THE TIMBER WITH NOBODY TO ANSWER IT. THE CHAPTER IS NOW UNCHANGED IN ITS MOVES AND ITS DATELINE.

MAJOR THREE, ONE CLOSING FRAME IN NINE OF THE TEN. EACH ENDED ON A QUANTIFIER AND A VERB AND THEN A BODY-PART AS SUBJECT: EACH ASPECT SPEAKS AND THE FINGERS TELL, EACH SIGHT STANDS AND THE ARM TELLS, BOTH VIEWS ARE TRUE AND THE FINGER KNOWS, AND THE SAME SHAPE IN 0899, 0900, 0901, 0902, 0903 AND, IN ITS SECOND PARAGRAPH, 0904, WHICH THE REVIEWER MISSED BECAUSE IT READ THE LAST LINE ONLY. ALL TEN PENULTIMATE SENTENCES WERE REWRITTEN INTO TEN DIFFERENT FRAMES AND THE TWO-VIEW PAIR IN EACH WAS LEFT ALONE.

MAJOR FOUR, *WHAT THE X WANTS IS* IN SIX CONSECUTIVE CHAPTERS, 0899 TO 0904, WITH 0902 AND 0904 THE SAME SENTENCE AND ONE NOUN SWAPPED. ALL SIX PRESCRIPTIONS WERE REWRITTEN IN SIX DIFFERENT FRAMES AND NONE OF THEM SAYS WHAT ANYTHING WANTS ANY MORE. NO PRESCRIPTION WAS ADDED OR REMOVED AND NOT ONE OF THEM IS ACTED ON.

MAJOR FIVE AND SIX, THE DECLARED WORD. FIRM IS RESTRICTED BY THIS FILE TO STONE BRICK TIMBER SOIL IRON AND NO OTHER SENSE, AND FIFTEEN OF ITS OCCURRENCES WERE ON GRIT DUST SAND LINSEED STAIN POINTING TURF AND CONCRETE, WHILE THE COUNTS PRINTED IN THE RECORD WERE WRONG IN THREE PLACES. EVERY OFF-LIST OCCURRENCE WAS CUT OR PUT ON THE LIST AND EVERY COUNT RE-TAKEN OFF THE FILES.

MAJOR SEVEN, THE MEASURE BOTH WAYS INSTRUCTION. THE FIRST VERSION OF THIS FILE PRINTED ONLY THE ALL-CAPS-OUT FIGURE AND NOT THE OTHER ONE, WHICH IS THREE SHARED TEN-TOKEN RUNS AND FOUR SHARED EIGHT-TOKEN RUNS. BOTH FIGURES ARE NOW ON THE PAGE AND NEITHER IS THE ZERO.

MAJOR EIGHT, THE SIXTEEN-SHAPE ROW CLAIMED ZERO PASSIVE AND WAS WRONG BY ITS OWN STANDARD. TWO *NONE* HITS WERE REWRITTEN AS THE CONDITION OF THE THING AND THE TEN PLAIN PAST-EVENT PASSIVES IN THE TEN OPENING SENTENCES ARE NOW NAMED AS WHAT THEY ARE.
